summary:
Stop running Claude Code on your phone. I tried it on holiday and it struggled.
How do you run AI agents while you're away? An old laptop connects to my PC at home, so all the power stays there. Hermes runs three jobs on top: video edits, my Notion board clean-up and Telegram messages. Every edit lands in Telegram as a preview and I say yes or no from my phone.
